headline: Brazil’s GOL Resumes Nonstop Rio-to-New York Flights
summary: GOL will restart nonstop flights from Rio de Janeiro to New York JFK on March 28, operating three times a week.
why: Airline route expansion restores key international transit corridors, signaling recovery in cross-border travel demand and boosting carrier revenue potential.

impacts.name: GOL Linhas Aéreas
impacts.why: Resuming a major international route expands operational capacity and revenue streams.
